signIn.title: Sign in to Devin
signIn.limit: This plugin can sign in and show the account's allowance, but it cannot send chats: Devin's chat protocol is not available to v2 plugins. Keep the v1 Devin plugin for chat.
signIn.browser.title: Browser sign-in
signIn.browser.body: Sign in at app.devin.ai in the browser. It ends on a 127.0.0.1 page that fails to load; copy that page's full address from the address bar and paste it below.
signIn.browser.label: Callback address (or just its code)
signIn.browser.state: That address is not from this sign-in; start again
signIn.token.title: Session token
signIn.token.body: Paste the devin CLI's session token: windsurf_api_key in its credentials.toml (~/.local/share/devin/ on Linux and macOS, %APPDATA%\devin\ on Windows).
signIn.token.label: Session token
